risk_note: RV2 (linking/**; user authorization: union_bindings.status written through the single entry canTransitionBinding + row_version CAS, approvals #26). GET /v1/unions/bindings refreshes the pdd filing: stored active / blocked are never queried; otherwise, with the site authorization of the account in use available, the self_buy identity (custom_parameters {app, uid=attr_code, sc}, no user_id) is sent to the governed queryPddAuthority outside any transaction; authorized -> one short transaction activates the binding (in place, stored unbound, or a new row; released history untouched; blocked never overwritten) and resolves the user's unresolved pdd conflict rows as bound_active (BR-ID-18). Not authorized or any failure -> nothing written, warn only, 200 with the stored projection; no link_logs, no state. The open's identity / query / activation code moved unchanged into application/pdd-authority.ts and is shared (reuse first).
